Maintain complete full silhouette with transparent padding on all edges; every toe, claw, gray head hair and tentacle fully inside. True RGBA transparent background, no backdrop, floor, shadows, fog, text or watermark. No genitals or sexual anatomy.

promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final transparent full-body enemy sprite for an existing 2D side-view combat game.
Input image: existing BLOODSUCKER sprite as the exact anatomical and rendering reference. Create a newly redesigned STRONGLAV, a visibly taller and much more muscular relative of this Bloodsucker. Preserve its recognizable elongated bald forehead, recessed predatory eye, fleshy mouth tentacles, clawed hands and humanoid legs/feet. Make the silhouette tall and imposing, less crouched than the reference, with a thicker muscular neck, broad powerful shoulders, strongly developed upper arms, forearms, thighs and calves. Keep the Bloodsucker facial anatomy recognizable; do not turn it into an ape or wolf.
Essential requested surface features: coarse GRAY/SILVER body hair growing from its skin across shoulders, upper back, arms, chest, flanks and thighs. Through and from UNDER this gray hair, organic SPIKED CHITINOUS PLATES visibly peek out. Distinct dark gray-brown segmented hard chitin plates on shoulders, spine, outer forearms and outer thighs, bearing pointed natural chitin spikes; the gray hair overlaps and partially covers the plate bases while their ridges and spikes protrude. Both silver hair and spiky plates must be legible at game size. Retain visible pale gray leathery skin between hair patches and plates. These are part of the mutant's body, not worn armor. No costume, no metal, no weapons.
Composition: one complete creature ONLY, facing LEFT toward the player in strict lateral side combat stance. Head, eye, mouth tentacles, chest and feet aim LEFT; do not stare at the viewer. Near arm reaching forward left ready to strike; far arm lower behind. Entire head, every mouth tentacle, hands, claws, feet, hair and spikes fully within canvas with at least 6 percent clear transparent padding on all sides. Both feet on same ground baseline, but no drawn ground. Tall portrait or near-square composition with naturally taller proportions. Full body from head to toes.
Style: detailed gritty realistic game creature render matching the reference, neutral diffuse light, muted natural colors, clearly modeled muscles, individual gray hairs and hard organic chitin texture. Actual RGBA alpha transparency outside silhouette and between limbs/tentacles. No painted background, no brown haze, no black fill, no floor, no shadow, no mist, no text, no labels, no extra views, no border, no watermark. No exposed sexual anatomy. Do not just stretch the old image: redraw anatomy with the described hair and chitin.

promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: final transparent Stronglav enemy sprite for a 2D side-view game.
Edit the attached Stronglav sprite, retaining its Bloodsucker identity, left-facing combat pose, recognizable bald elongated head with fleshy mouth tentacles, huge muscular humanoid anatomy, and organic spiked chitin plates peeking through the hair. He is an approximately THREE-METRE-TALL elder Bloodsucker, taller, stronger, much heavier and more muscular than an ordinary Bloodsucker; emphasize massive shoulders, chest, arms and thighs, long powerful legs, formidable weight.
Apply these specific corrections requested by the game creator:
1. Numerous clearly healed old battle scars across ALL visible skin: irregular round bullet scars, long cut scars, and crescent bite scars on the skull, chest, arms, flanks, thighs and shins. These are old scar tissue, no open wounds or exposed organs.
2. Coarse long GRAY/SILVER hair grows on arms, legs and torso. Around the lower torso and hips, this body hair lengthens into a dense natural skirt of hanging coarse hair that fully covers the entire groin, buttocks and rear pelvis, extending to upper/mid thigh. It is natural body hair, not a worn garment. The same gray hair continues down arms and legs and partially overlaps the chitin plates.
3. Hair roots and upper hair are gray/silver. Toward the lower lengths and tips the hair transitions into DARK SWAMP-GREEN, mossy deep olive-green, especially clearly on the long pelvic hair skirt and lower limb hair. Preserve visible separation of individual gray and dark green strands. Do not make the whole body green.
4. Hands, fingers and claws bear visible dark red blood stains and smears, especially fingertips and claw bases. Keep this localized to hands/fingers/claws, realistic and readable, without gore, body parts or victims.
Composition invariants: entire body visible from head/spikes to all claw tips and feet; head, gaze and chest remain directed LEFT toward player, not looking at camera; side-view stance, one near arm reaches forward left, far arm behind; both feet on one baseline, no drawn floor. Enlarge canvas or zoom out enough to provide at least 6% fully transparent padding at ALL edges: do not cut fingers, back arm, tentacles, hair, spikes, head or toes.
Retain gritty detailed realistic game-art rendering and neutral diffuse light. Actual RGBA transparent background, including between fingers/arms/tentacles/legs and fine hair edges. No background, no fog, no shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no border, no extra creatures, no genitals or exposed sexual anatomy. Preserve the natural gray-brown chitin plates and pointed spikes. Output ONE finished full-body sprite.

promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the Stronglav sprite to simplify. Image 2 is an ordinary Bloodsucker reference ONLY for the mouth anatomy and number of tentacles.
The creator says the Stronglav is visually too busy, especially too many mouth tentacles. Make a cleaner, restrained version of IMAGE 1.
MOST IMPORTANT: rebuild the mouth with EXACTLY FOUR fleshy tentacles TOTAL, matching the ordinary Bloodsucker in IMAGE 2. Four distinct simple appendages hanging from the mouth, easy to count, no extra short tentacles, no branching tentacles, no curled mandibles, no fleshy whiskers or beard. Keep the recognizable Bloodsucker head and strict leftward gaze. Fewer thicker relaxed tentacles, not a tangled cluster. Do not count hands, hair or spikes as tentacles.
Simplify the other details substantially: reduce the total number of chitin plates, small spikes and bony projections by about HALF. Keep just a few broad natural chitin patches partially under the hair at the shoulder, forearm and outer thigh, each bearing only one or two short spines. Retain old healed bullet/cut/bite scars distributed on visible skin, but group them more naturally and reduce their visual contrast; no fresh open wounds or round bloody holes.
Preserve the defining user-requested features: unique approximately3-metre powerful heavy muscular elder Bloodsucker, bigger and stronger than the normal Bloodsucker; gray/silver hair on arms/legs/torso with dark swamp-green lower tips; natural long pelvic hair skirt covering groin and rear, not a garment; localized dark blood stains on hands/fingers/claws; VERY faint pale yellow-green eye glint. Keep anatomy and muscles clearly readable, calmer surface texture.
Retain left-facing side combat pose of IMAGE1 and full-body view. Zoom the character OUT by about15% inside a larger transparent canvas. IMPORTANT: provide a continuous completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT BORDER of at least60 pixels on every edge, especially the RIGHT hand and RIGHT foot; no body/hair/fingers/spikes may touch any canvas edge. All four tentacle tips and all claws inside image. No crop.
Style: gritty realistic game creature sprite with natural muted colors and neutral diffuse light, same quality as input.
